title: Exact Cyclotomic and Constructive Lean 4 Certificates for Symmetric Identities and Determinants of Legendre-Symbol Matrices
abstract: Roman Le Lan and Keqin Liu (arXiv:2611.33667v1, Nov. 2026) prove Zhi-Wei Sun's Conjecture 3.2(i), evaluating the four-parameter Legendre-symbol determinant A(x,y,z,w) for every prime p > 3 in terms of the fundamental unit eps_p and class number h_p of Q(sqrt(p)) when p = 1 (mod 4) and powers of 2 when p = 3 (mod 4). We provide an independent, unrefereed companion certification suite (LEGENDRE-DET-SYM-CERT-1.0) comprising 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice), a strictly zero-floating-point Python verifier computing exact arithmetic in Q and Q[zeta_p] = Q[X]/(Phi_p(X)) across four verification modes (eight submodes), 16 canonical JSON certificates spanning p in [5, 229] (including h_{-23}=3 and h_{229}=3), and 38 unit and adversarial forgery tests.
